items.title: Mrs. Francis Oliver Interview, 1969-05-10
items.q: I was 16 years old when you were present... I have all these that you wrote to my sister... I have so many things out of place upstairs... letters that I got from this gentleman

ctx.x: And now, I have two other pictures where he's, when he's working on the RKS circuit with other men One way of a guy sitting at the table, sitting on top of the piano, and the other picture I have, he's standing up, he's full height in a dress suit But he was playing down, up down, he came down from Chicago to Memphis, and he wanted us to come out there And my grandmother didn't want me to go, she said I hadn't been traveling enough to go to a small town
You were a young girl, but you said you were 16 when your, Jolly sent you these
That's right, I was 16 years old when you were present, that's right
